Title: Azure Site Recovery: Scout 8.0.1 Update 3 is available

Body.Content:
Scout 8.0.1 Update 3 is a cumulative update for Azure Site Recovery that contains Update 1, Update 2, and new fixes. You can apply Update 3 directly on Scout 8.0.1 in general availability.

To learn more about Update 3 fixes, and to get download and installation instructions, see the Replicate on-premises VMware virtual machines or physical servers to a secondary site article.
